facts.value: Inline six-cylinder, direct-injection industrial diesel; EMS, turbocharger, charge-air cooler, thermostatically controlled cooling and electronic speed control.
DCU can display engine speed, charge pressure, coolant temperature, charge-air temperature, oil pressure, oil temperature, engine hours, battery voltage and fuel consumption.
260–560 kPa for hot engine at 1900 rpm.
facts.condition: Do not use as a Gen 1 alarm threshold until exact installed model/speed limits are verified.

facts.value: SPN 99 oil-filter differential pressure; SPN 100 engine oil pressure; SPN 102 boost pressure; SPN 110 coolant temperature; SPN 111 coolant level; SPN 636 camshaft sensor; SPN 637 crankshaft sensor; SPN 651–656 cylinder injectors.
Excessive coolant temperature investigation includes coolant level, air in coolant system, circulating pump and thermostat.
Engine labels are on the valve cover and include serial identification; exact installed variant must be confirmed from the engine label.
